body:
Conflicts cleared (M5 session, at the contributor's request): merged current main (`d0f0a80b`) now that #476 and #482 are in. Two keep-both conflicts:
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/fixture_menu.rs`: this PR's Save/Insert-from-library entries on the Fixtures menu, plus main's new `TreeMenuTarget::Entry(_)` arm.
- `crates/ui/src/state.rs`: this PR's `fixture_library` module, plus main's `program_entry` / `tool_body` / `tool_profile` modules.

Re-run on the merged tree:
- app: `c_axis_fixture` 2, `carried_fixtures_cache` 6, `fixture_law_gaps` 3, `fixture_library` 6, `fixture_mesh_posed` 2, `fixture_mesh` 3, `fixture_ux` 9, `fixtures` 14, `rotary_fixtures` 4, all passing.
- ui: `tests/fixtures` 7 and the lib fixture tests 13, all passing.
- `clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -D warnings` clean.

Still a draft; the M3 session owns the rest of it (pull before pushing again).

Hands-on kit driven headless through the real shell (egui_kittest at 1280x720, real right-clicks, dialog clicks, typing and Cmd+Z/Cmd+Y). It ran on a copy of the kit project with a temp library folder.
- **Save:** the menu rows, dialog path and checkboxes are right; status "saved 1 fixture(s)". The file has format/version/units and one facet per line. The Replace prompt works, and Cancel leaves the file byte-identical. A bottom-centre datum lands at (0, -41, -5). "not saved: check a fixture to save" appears when nothing is checked. **Pass.**
- **Insert:** JawHi (2) lands exactly on JawHi. It is one undo step, and redo brings it back still a fixture. JawLo (2) at Z 30 with yaw 90 has its bottom centre at (0, 0, 30) and runs along Y. **Pass.**
- **Round trip:** after Save As and reopen, JawHi (2) and JawLo (2) keep their transforms and stay fixtures. **Pass.**
- **Delete:** Keep leaves the file unchanged. Delete edits only the library; the document is untouched and not dirty. **Pass.**
- **Corrupt library:** a version-2 file is named in the dialog. Insert is disabled, and the save is refused without overwriting the file. **Pass.**
- **Two notes, both non-blocking:**
  - The kit's step 2.2 expected `mesh`. JawHi (2) and JawHi actually read "box only: shared box". This is #482's designed fallback for two fixtures with identical world boxes (`fixture_view.rs:89-90`), so the kit text was wrong.
  - Replace takes the new dialog's note, so replacing with a blank note erases the old one. That's arguably fine; keeping the old note when the new one is blank could be a follow-up.

<!-- review-cost: estimated -->
**Estimated agent cost:** ~$3.39 (rough estimate from size: 1453 changed lines)

No token usage was recorded for this PR, so this is calibrated from PRs with measured cost (our fix PRs, fix agent + review: median ~$1.20, ~$2.33 per 1,000 changed lines; floor $0.15, cap ~$3.60). For a contributor's PR it estimates what writing and reviewing it the way our agents work would cost, not what their session actually spent.

Blended upper estimate: 90 % input / 10 % output at list price (Opus 5.5 ~$5.60/M, Sonnet 5.5 ~$2.80/M, Haiku 5.5 ~$0.14/M). Cache reads make the real cost lower; main-session coordination isn't counted.
